originalTitle: 【DRAW MY LIFE】the stream and MINI ANNOUNCEMENT
lead: The creator shared a mini-announcement, noting that today is the 25th and that the song is being released. The song features instrumental music mixed by Bianco Boy, and the artwork resembles an album cover. The creator is happy with the artwork and is pictured on a pillow. The creator also mentioned that they plan to share the image on a later post and asked listeners to save the song on Spotify. This is a short announcement, and the creator expressed that the song is important to them, particularly in karaoke. They also mentioned liking Levee's music, which is an English cover of the song, and noted that the song will be released in one week, likely around midnight or in the morning.

articleBodyHtml:
Mini Announcement and Song Release

The creator shared a mini-announcement, noting that today is the 25th and that the song is being released. The song features instrumental music mixed by Bianco Boy, and the artwork resembles an album cover. The creator is happy with the artwork and is pictured on a pillow. The creator also mentioned that they plan to share the image on a later post and asked listeners to save the song on Spotify. This is a short announcement, and the creator expressed that the song is important to them, particularly in karaoke. They also mentioned liking Levee's music, which is an English cover of the song, and noted that the song will be released in one week, likely around midnight or in the morning.
